email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoInsulex patient with mild nausea
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a staff pharmacist at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 43-year-old male patient with a history of type 1 diabetes received their fourth dose of DemoInsulex (dose: 10 mg).
Treatment started on 2026-03-10.
Approximately 6 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild nausea.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
T. Novak (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
